name: R K Electronics Inc
old_description: designs and manufactures electrical automation control components. We provide standard products that have many applications with a variety of customers and custom products. The custom products are typically designed for use in our customer's equipment and machinery control systems.
about:
R-K Electronics is based in Mason, Ohio, and traces its roots to February 1949 when Bill Keller and John Runge founded R-K Electric Company, Inc. as a panel builder serving steel mills, machine tool builders, and paper manufacturers across Ohio, Indiana, and Kentucky.

Today the company designs and manufactures a range of electronic automation control components, from intrinsically safe low‑voltage relays to 600‑volt three‑phase monitoring controls. In addition to its standard product line, R-K develops custom processor‑based embedded controllers—dedicated PLCs with hardware, firmware, and packaging tailored to OEM specifications—for equipment and machinery control systems.

R-K’s customers span the electrical controls industry and OEMs in sectors such as heating and refrigeration, pumping and level control, as well as the original steel, machine tool, and paper markets. The company supplies both off‑the‑shelf components and fully customized control solutions built to each OEM’s operating requirements.

The founder’s original decision to start the business because they “couldn’t do any worse working for themselves” evolved into a stated philosophy of customer‑driven innovation: R-K emphasizes listening to customers to create control components with unique features that simplify control requirements and make customers more successful. Ongoing development includes controls that interface with the company’s own color touch screens.

name: R P Foods
old_description: RP Foods was founded in 1999 working almost exclusively in Hispanic grocery category. Our staff has over 20 years of retail and importing experience.
about:
RP Foods was founded in 1999 in Dallas, Texas. The company began working almost exclusively in the Hispanic grocery category, leveraging over 20 years of retail and importing experience among its staff.

The company imports products from Mexico, Asia, and Europe, and operates its own facility in Dallas along with third‑party logistics locations in Laredo, Texas; Atlanta, Georgia; and Montebello, California. It focuses on providing retailers with products that enhance category offerings and meet current shopper demands.

RP Foods serves distributors and retailers nationwide, primarily in the Hispanic grocery segment that is transitioning into the general market. Its customer base includes retailers seeking to expand their product assortments with relevant items.

The company emphasizes customer service and aims to be a valuable resource for customers seeking new products, though no specific founding mission or differentiator beyond service is stated.

name: R W Specialties
old_description: With years of experience in stair part distribution, RW America specializes in providing a comprehensive selection of stair parts to complete any project. This includes newel posts, box newels, iron and wooden balusters, handrails, and all other stair components to elevate any interior space.
about:
RW America, operating as R W Specialties, is a specialty building product wholesale distributor headquartered in Bar Nunn, Wyoming, with a major hub in Commerce City, Colorado. The company traces its roots back more than five decades, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared publicly.

The company distributes a broad range of building materials across seven locations in the Mountain West and Midwest. Its catalog encompasses more than 7,000 SKUs, including stair parts such as newel posts, balusters, and handrails; decking and porch systems; weatherization products as a qualified Tyvek distributor; cabinets and countertops; interior and exterior doors; and fire and hearth solutions. RW America supports both new construction and remodel projects, and offers job-site delivery, specialized training, and installation support for products such as Tyvek building wrap.

RW America serves residential and commercial construction professionals, as well as home improvement retail chains. Its customer base includes builders, remodelers, and retail outlets across the Mountain West region. The company also provides custom cabinetry design services through its cabinetry specialists.

The company emphasizes quality, expertise, and personalized service tailored to each project's unique requirements, positioning itself as a partner for construction and design needs.

name: R W Technologies
old_description: RW Technologies is a US-based electronic circuit board services company
about:
RW Technologies US LLC operates from Crystal Lake, Illinois, a northwest suburb of Chicago. The company was founded in 2011 by Troy Richert and Micheal Walker as a partnership to provide electronic manufacturing services.

The shop specializes in printed circuit board assembly, offering quick-turn prototypes, new product introduction (NPI) runs, and low-to-medium volume production. Its services extend to lead-free and mixed-technology assembly, surface-mount and through-hole placement, repairs and upgrades, parts procurement, component warehousing in an environmentally controlled stockroom, and box-build assembly including custom enclosures and wiring. All work is performed in the company's own facility outside Chicago.

RW Technologies serves multiple industries, with a noted example of camera modules for the telecommunications sector. Its customer base includes engineers who need fast prototypes, low unit costs, flexible design specifications, and schedule certainty for product launches.

The company differentiates itself through what it calls a Trifold Tech Approach: superior U.S. quality backed by ISO 9001:2015 and IPC-A-610 compliance, quick and flexible turnarounds enabled by lean manufacturing principles, and global cost competitiveness achieved through low overhead and manufacturing efficiencies. The founders emphasize that they are not merely order takers but partners who build each board as if it were their own.

name: R&D Fabworks, LLC
old_description: From statement pieces to one-of-a-kind builds, we specialize in custom fabrication that brings your ideas to life.
about:
R&D Fabworks, LLC is based in Crittenden, Kentucky, and was founded in 2016 by Garrett Daniels. After studying mechanical engineering at the University of Kentucky and earning AWS certifications at the Knight School of Welding, Daniels spent years in production welding and machining while building the business on nights and weekends. He committed to the company full-time in 2019 with the support of his wife, Amanda, and the shop has since grown from a custom off-road fabrication startup into a full-service metal fabrication and welding operation serving the Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky region.

The company provides custom metal fabrication, welding (MIG, TIG, stick), CNC plasma cutting, plate and sheet rolling, tube rolling and bending, and structural fabrication including mezzanines, catwalks, safety railings, ADA ramps and handrails. It also offers marine construction and repair such as marina builds, boat lifts, and aluminum boat repair, as well as mobile welding for on-site equipment and trailer repair. The shop handles one-off prototypes through large production runs and works with materials ranging from carbon steel and stainless steel to titanium, Inconel, Monel, Hastelloy, copper-nickel alloys, and copper and brass brazing.

R&D Fabworks serves residential homeowners, commercial property owners, contractors, industrial facilities, marinas, and fleet operators primarily within a three-hour radius of Cincinnati. Typical projects include custom staircases, railings, and outdoor structures for homes; safety railings, ADA-compliant access systems, and structural platforms for commercial and industrial buildings; and emergency mobile welding for heavy equipment, trailers, and cast-iron components.

The company emphasizes a ‘do it right, don’t cut corners’ philosophy, stating that it treats every project as the only one on the schedule and backs its work with over 47 AWS certifications, licensed and insured status, and a commitment to fast response times for emergency repairs.

name: R.M. Flagg Restaurant Supply
old_description: R.M. Flagg has been in business since 1928. Our customer service and expertise have stood the test of time.
about:
R.M. Flagg Restaurant Supply has operated from Veazie, Maine since 1928. The family-owned business began as a local source for restaurant equipment and kitchen supplies and has remained under family stewardship for nearly a century.

The company functions as a full-line dealer for major food-service equipment brands, stocking more than 10,000 items across two on-site warehouses and a showroom. Its product range spans commercial refrigeration, cooking equipment, small wares, bar supplies, countertop appliances, furniture, and disposables. Beyond sales, Flagg provides complete kitchen design packages using AutoCAD drawings and schematics, and its own installation crew handles delivery and setup of commercial equipment throughout Maine.

Customers include independent restaurants, convenience-store chains, summer camps, food trucks, hospitals, schools, and the general public. The firm serves both small single-item orders and large multi-site rollouts, with project experience ranging from custom refrigeration to full dining-room fit-outs.

Flagg emphasizes its local, family-owned structure as a differentiator, citing the ability to offer personalized service, deep product knowledge, and hassle-free project management from design through installation.

name: RAM Group Inc.
old_description: RAM Group, INC. is an American apparel and clothing manufacturer based in Milwaukee Wisconsin that specializes in dye sublimation printing. Originally founded as a graphic design firm in the early 90’s, we’ve evolved into a multi-functional apparel manufacturing company that serves many brands and organizations throughout the United States.
about:
RAM Group Inc. The company remains privately held, though the ownership structure is not publicly detailed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The firm specializes in dye sublimation printing and handles the entire production cycle in-house: design, printing, cutting, and sewing. Its Milwaukee facility has produced a wide range of custom apparel for over two decades, and since March 2020 it has manufactured nearly one million cloth face masks and facial coverings in response to the pandemic. Services also include merchandising and shipping.

Customers include sports teams, organizations, athletes, and brands across the United States. The pandemic-era mask output demonstrates capacity for large-scale, rapid-turnaround orders, while the core business serves clients seeking custom sublimated uniforms, performance wear, and promotional apparel.

Leadership emphasizes that keeping every step of production in the United States is a quality decision, not a marketing slogan. They argue that craftsmanship depends on the people employed and the production practices used, and that outsourcing would erode the standard they maintain.

name: RANDYS Worldwide Headquarters
old_description: Products engineered for performance and rigorously tested for reliability.
about:
RANDYS Worldwide is headquartered in Everett, Washington, and has operated since 1982. The company entered the market as a supplier of undercar components and has grown into a multi-brand manufacturer and distributor serving the automotive aftermarket across North America.

RANDYS designs, engineers, and manufactures a range of drivetrain, suspension, towing, and wheel products under a family of brands that includes Dynatrac, Yukon Gear & Axle, USA Standard Gear, ICON Vehicle Dynamics, Carli Suspension, Cognito Motorsports, and BulletProof Hitches. The company operates two high-tech testing labs at its Everett facility to validate products against strict specifications, and holds 13 design patents. A network of 13 distribution centers enables same-day shipping that reaches 95 percent of U.S. customers within one to two days. RANDYS also provides remanufacturing services, technical support, installation manuals, and gear-ratio calculators.

Customers range from weekend off-road enthusiasts to professional installers and large retail accounts. The company supplies both performance-oriented aftermarket parts and OE replacement components for light-truck and SUV platforms. Its product lines cover differentials and traction devices, suspension and steering systems, driveshafts, towing hitches, wheels, and off-road armor.

RANDYS emphasizes its combination of in-house engineering, rigorous testing, and deep technical knowledge as its primary differentiators. The company states that its engineering team continuously refines designs, its testing labs ensure only approved products reach the market, and its sales and technical staff provide installation guidance tailored to each vehicle’s specifications and usage.

name: RAUMEDIC
old_description: We are breaking new ground and finding new ways to improve medical care worldwide with our products and services.
about:
RAUMEDIC is a German medical technology company with a U.S. presence in Mills River, North Carolina. The company operates as RAUMEDIC AG, headquartered in Helmbrechts, Germany, and focuses on polymer-based solutions for medical and pharmaceutical applications. No founding year or founders are disclosed in the provided materials.

The company develops and manufactures polymer-based components and systems for intensive care and biopharma fluid handling. Its capabilities span material development, product concept design, precise prototyping, and a variety of manufacturing technologies under one roof, including clean room production. RAUMEDIC also provides regulatory support toward product registration. The firm notes "production sites worldwide" and "square meters of clean room production space," though specific figures are not given.

RAUMEDIC serves the medical technology and pharmaceutical sectors, with application areas including cardiosurgery, cell and gene therapy, drug delivery, enteral feeding, infusion, neuromonitoring, ophthalmology, orthopedics, pharma fluid handling, and traumatology. Customers range from biopharma companies needing single-use bioprocess equipment to device manufacturers requiring catheter systems for physiological monitoring.

The company emphasizes an integrated "Everything From One Source" approach, combining material expertise, design, manufacturing, and regulatory services. Sustainability is highlighted through on-site renewable energy generation — a biomass heating plant and roughly 2,500 solar panels at its German headquarters — and a green product development program using novel biopolymers to reduce carbon footprint.
